scripts.android:add: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-android.ps1 assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-android.ps1 bundleRelease
